Subject: Post-call: SLOs & customer-led load test coordination

Thanks for taking the call earlier, Sarah — quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before the customer-led load test.

Summary of requirements we captured on the call:
- P95 latency target: <= 250ms for streaming generation (short prompts, ~256 tokens).
- Throughput: target sustained ~600 requests/sec during peak simulations.
- Concurrency: test profile should model ~500 concurrent clients with ramp periods.
- Streaming: need chunked/streaming responses (server-sent events) enabled — customer will validate partial-token latencies.
- Auth & quotas: customer will use a test API key; they asked for pinning to a dedicated test pool if possible.

Proposed customer-led test window: Wednesday 18 Feb 2026, 22:00 - 02:00 PST (overnight for FinWise infra). Please confirm if this works for your team.

Requested from FinWise before the run:
1) Confirm the exact test window (above).
2) Provide the public IP ranges that need to be allowlisted on our side (or confirm you want us to provide ours).
3) Confirm streaming protocol (SSE vs WebSocket) — we support both; SSE is preferred for the work we discussed.
4) Point-of-contact for the run (name + mobile/email) so our on-call can coordinate.

Attached: starter k6 script and the test plan (k6_finwise_script.js, finwise_loadtest_plan.pdf) — these are a starting point; engineering can tweak ramp, stages, and payloads.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Provision a test API key scoped to the FinWise test with optional dedicated capacity (if committed).
- Provide IP ranges to allowlist for the test injector(s) and any dedicated test pool endpoints.
- Monitor live dashboards (Grafana link below) and be on call during the window.

If all looks good I'll loop in engineering to provision the test credentials and confirm the allowlist IPs.

Thanks,
Logan
